# 1DM

> 1DM (1DollarMoffe Pvt. Ltd.) is a specialty coffee cafe chain based in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India, with 10 outlets across 4 cities. Its sister brand, Kruptos Coffee Roasters, is Raipur's first specialty coffee roastery, roasting seed-to-cup for 1DM's cafes and selling its own coffee direct to consumers.

This site (1dm.coffee) does not sell coffee beans, equipment, or merchandise — all buy-or-rent commerce for roasted coffee and brewing equipment happens on kruptoscoffee.com. 1dm.coffee covers cafe locations and menus, brand story, and 1DM Elite Club membership.

## Brand
- Full name: 1DollarMoffe — founded 2019 in Pune, India, when the first cup off a coffee truck was priced at $1 (the origin of the name).
- Tagline: "Specialty coffee, for everyone."
- Operated by 1DollarMoffe Pvt. Ltd.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/1dollarmoffee/
- Contact: hello@1dm.coffee

## Locations
10 cafe outlets across 4 cities in Chhattisgarh, India: Raipur (7), Bhilai (1), Bilaspur (1), Jagdalpur (1).

Open now:
- 1DM Samta, Raipur — 11:00 AM – 10:30 PM, daily
- 1DM Dumartarai, Raipur — 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM, closed Sundays
- 1DM Avanti Vihar, Raipur — 9:00 AM – 10:30 PM, closed Thursdays
- 1DM Tagore Nagar, Raipur — 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM, daily
- Slice By 1DM Shankar Nagar, Raipur — 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM, closed Tuesdays
- 1DM Bhilai, Bhilai — 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM, closed Mondays
- 1DM Bilaspur, Bilaspur — 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM, daily

Coming soon: 1DM Civil Line (Raipur), Slice By 1DM VIP Road (Raipur), 1DM Jagdalpur (Jagdalpur).

Full list with maps: https://1dm.coffee/locations

## Menu
Menus vary by outlet — full items and pricing at https://1dm.coffee/menu. Categories include water-based coffee (espresso, americano, cold brew), milk-based lattes (flat white, cappuccino, Spanish/Vietnamese/honey-cinnamon lattes), teas and refreshers (matcha, chai, hibiscus), and artisan food, toasts, and bowls. 1DM Bilaspur's menu is fresh bakes and desserts made in partnership with Brownie & Co.

## Kruptos Coffee Roasters
Kruptos is 1DM's own roastery — Raipur's first specialty coffee roastery, roasting seed-to-cup, launched in 2026 out of Bilaspur. It supplies 1DM's cafes and sells its own roasted coffee direct at https://kruptoscoffee.com, alongside brewing equipment (grinders, kettles, scales, drippers) for sale or rent. Current release: "Stairway to Heaven" (Side A & Side B), ₹300.

More: https://1dm.coffee/kruptos

## 1DM Elite Club
Paid membership: ₹5,999 for new members, ₹2,999 annual renewal, capped at 5 new members a month. Perks: 10% off everything plus a birthday perk, priority seating, a ₹3,500/month credit line, zero-deposit equipment rental from ₹1,200/month (10% of rental payments credits toward eventual purchase, plus a free 3-day trial), 15 hours/year of brewing classes, and invitation-only Member Circle events. Partner perks include Kruptos Roastery (10% off beans) and Chakara Fitness discounts.

Details: https://1dm.coffee/club · Chakara Privilege: https://1dm.coffee/club/chakara-privilege

## Roasters on the bar
1DM's cafes rotate coffee from five roasters: Bloom Coffee Roasters, Capulus Beans, Rossette Coffee Lab, Naivo Coffee Company, and Kruptos Coffee Roasters (its own).

## Team
Akhand — founder; personally signs off on everything that goes on the menu. Tushar Nagarchi — barista trainer, multiple barista championship wins, SCA Authorized Barista, Coffee Board of India Certified. Abhishek Mishra — brewing/extraction, 2nd place Indian AeroPress Championship 2023 (National Level), SCA Certified Barista. Shreya Mishra — Head Barista. Shreya Sahu — Beverage R&D Lead / Assistant Roaster at Kruptos. Adnan Sheikh — Head Chef. Sanskar — Food Consultant.

## Milestones
- 2019, Pune: India's first multi-roaster coffee-truck/cafe concept; founding cup priced at $1.
- 2021, Raipur: first to bring specialty coffee culture to Raipur/Chhattisgarh; the team became the first from Chhattisgarh to win coffee trophies at state and national level.
- 2022: India's first techno rave held inside a coffee shop.
- 2025: opened six outlets in one year; first cafe brand in India to champion reusable cups.
- 2026, Bilaspur: Kruptos Coffee Roasters launches, seed-to-cup — 1DM's tenth outlet.
